note: docs/design/FLOOR.md Appendix B row 14's scene runs (card#7341 step 11) — AT-D3-19 and AT-D3-20. Each run replays one of § 11's fixtures, `fx-snapshot-4` or `fx-interns`, as its own note says; they live in one file of their own so the room drawing's scenarios read together. A map written `@json:resources/floor/default.tmj` is the shipped default itself — re-authored to the furniture box by row 14's slice B, so the GREEN clauses run on it — a tileset `@text:` the vendored file, and `@box.*` the furniture box resources/floor/furniture-box.js declares, which the runs that PLANT a map defect (two slots, a crowded pair, an undersized slot) build their stub maps from; the probe resolves each (fleet-client-probe.mjs), so no copy of any of them is kept here.

scene_default.note: Appendix B row 14's scene over the SHIPPED default map (`@json:` is the file itself, never a copy), every seat at `task.title`'s bound — AT-D3-19's intact control, and AT-D3-20's GREEN clauses and its positive control: the default is re-authored to the furniture box (row 14, slice B), so every desk lies inside its slot and no F21 line is emitted.
